pr_title: fix(jsx): allow passing variables into mount

issue_context.title: Issue with component testing / possibly intended behaviour
issue_context.body:
I have recently set up the experimental component testing feature of Playwright Test 1.22.2

I am using it with a React repo and have noticed some interesting behaviour when you pass in extracted components stored as consts.

Example

This works:

```
const alert = () => (
  <Alert type="info" title={'test'} id="alert" message={'hello'} />
)

test('should work', async ({ mount }) => {
  const component = await mount(alert())
  await expect(component).toContainText(alertMsg)
})
```

This fails:

```
const alert = (
  <Alert type="info" title={'test'} id="alert" message={'hello'} />
)

test('should work', async ({ mount }) => {
  const component = await mount(alert)
  await expect(component).toContainText(alertMsg)
})
```

In both cases the const appears to be a valid JSX.Element? The error is: 

```
undefined: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
    at render (http://localhost:3100/assets/index.22f7df41.js:2257:84)
    at window.playwrightMount (http://localhost:3100/assets/index.22f7df41.js:2274:19)
    at eval (eval at evaluate (:178:30), <anonymous>:19:25)
    at UtilityScript.evaluate (<anonymous>:180:17)
    at UtilityScript.<anonymous> (<anonymous>:1:44)
    at src/components/Alert/Alert.spec.pw.tsx:18:27
```

Interestingly, both of the above work with Cypress component testing. So wondering if Playwright is enforcing something specific here?
